# Claude Code 2.1.270 identity

Frozen against npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.270` and GitHub
`v2.1.270`. Every published stable between the qualified `2.1.257` ceiling
and official `2.1.270` was retrieved and classified: `2.1.258`, `2.1.259`,
`2.1.260`, `2.1.261`, `2.1.263`, `2.1.265`, `2.1.266`, `2.1.267`, `2.1.268`,
`2.1.269`, and `2.1.270`. `2.1.262` and `2.1.264` are unpublished.

The host `claude` is exact `2.1.258`, SHA-256
`b63136194160791c27cfa7b0403060d85eb0752991625fde8c09f9acacb17c78`. The host
was observed, not installed or updated. Host `--help` is byte-identical to
the frozen `2.1.257` help digest
(`a0ab4f1df36388fba86563a10839c020cc7dcb13cec2311c336aebe6963db0a1`), so the
`2.1.258` help surface did not move. Downloaded official `2.1.270` binaries
were hashed and never executed; no newer hops were executed.

Wrapper installer files except `package.json` and `sdk-tools.d.ts` are
byte-identical across all twelve compared versions. Selected mapped headless
and response-only flags, format choices, effort and permission enumerations,
and the stream-JSON init/result/stream-event/hook/thinking-tokens shapes stay.
`dist-inventory.json` freezes hop-by-hop wrapper and platform-package file
counts, exact added/removed/changed/identical sets, tarball and binary
digests, and npm/GitHub publication identity.

`identity.json` and `protocol.json` record the headless axis.
`response-only.json` records the separate response-only axis. Neither
replaces the `claude-code-2.1.220` headless decoder specimen, the
`2.1.227`/`2.1.228` response-only specimens, nor the frozen `2.1.234`/
`2.1.235`/`2.1.238`/`2.1.241`/`2.1.251`/`2.1.252`/`2.1.257` corpora.
Maximum-turn and other feature-specific exact version sets stay on the
`2.1.220..=2.1.241` probed sets.

Watcher help/digest stays on exact `2.1.251`; this family does not copy those
fixtures, does not raise `CLAUDE_CODE_WATCHER_VERSION`, and does not widen
watcher help, digest, or live authorization. No provider prompt was sent.
